scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

The imported record has map coverage 1492 to 1500 CE near Silvia, Cauca. This is not the lifetime of the Ambaló people. Later evidence is explicitly dated and no modern practice is projected back to 1492.

The CRIC profile has distinct sections for eleven peoples. Only Pueblo Ampiule is used for Ambaló clothing and language. Namtrik relationships do not collapse Misak, Kishú, Totoroez and Ambaló into one polity.

The August 2016 authority statement is a community account of dispossession and recovery, not an independently examined title judgment. Conflicting territorial assertions in neighboring sources are not resolved here, and imported geometry is not certified.

The September 2016 statement celebrates 33 years since reconstitution, implying 1983; the CRIC profile describes election/recognition in 1984. The public card acknowledges the difference instead of assigning an exact institutional founding date.
The period labels 2009, 2014 and 2021 identify documented reports or projects, not exhaustive history or claims that activity ended in the following year.

Nancy Bravo Chantre writes as a participant in regional Indigenous food-autonomy work. Only the Ambaló-specific plant-research passage is treated as local practice. Regional lists of crops, barter goods and other peoples’ ceremonies are not reassigned to Ambaló.

The Miraflores school blog identifies authors, institution, date and planned tasks. Proposed results are not reported as accomplished measurements. Its background quotation about Nasa gardens is not converted into an Ambaló origin account. Photographs and video were not examined.

The UAIIN catalog synopsis for Corredor biológico was read in indexed PDF text. The audiovisual item itself was not viewed and has no stated production date. No archaeological discoveries or quantified conservation effects are invented.

The 2021 communication report is a participant source. The 2025 recollection identifies José Miguel Niquinás as Ampiulle from Ambaló, but López Adentro’s rice business and Nasa-language programs are not labeled Ambaló institutions.
No singular conquest or successor is manufactured for a continuing people. Independent historical review and depth certification remain pending.
